summary: Tested iteration-3 Church Name feature end-to-end: (1) new backend endpoint PUT /api/appearance/church-name with settings-token auth, trim, 120-char limit, empty allowed; (2) new appearance fields church_name_show/position/size/color/uppercase on both register & bible with Position Literal + hex validation; (3) church_name included in public /api/register/display and /api/bible/display payloads; (4) full UI flow in SettingsAdmin: both Bible and Register tabs render church-name-panel, church-name-input shared, show/position/size/color/uppercase controls, dirty-state fires on name-only change, save persists name + per-display styling; (5) live /register and /bible WebSocket-driven displays render church-name-top / church-name-bottom with correct data-position, text, color, text-transform; (6) per-display independence verified — top-center on /register coexists with bottom-right on /bible; hiding on /bible leaves /register unaffected; (7) regression on existing appearance (parallax, panel_opacity, colors), PIN change + pin_version token invalidation. Added test_church_name.py (14 new tests, all pass). All 68 backend tests pass sequentially; 2/68 flake only under xdist loadscope parallelism because TestChangePin temporarily rotates the shared PIN while another worker tries to unlock — pre-existing cross-worker race unrelated to this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: appearance.py: church_name is stored on site_settings (shared), styling fields on display_appearance (per-display) — clean separation; GET /appearance/{display} returns both. Good.
appearance_routes.py update_church_name trims and broadcasts to BOTH register and bible channels — correct for shared field. Good.

ChurchName component in DisplayBackground.jsx returns null when vert !== place, which lets the same element be rendered twice (top slot + bottom slot) with only the matching one visible — simple and robust.

church-name-size slider uses testid pattern '{testid}-slider' from RangeField, so the testids on the slider itself are 'church-name-size-slider' / '-value' / '-field' rather than literal 'church-name-size' — functionally fine, worth noting for future test-id docs.

update_appearance uses full-replace $set with model_dump(); partial PUT bodies would reset other fields to defaults — frontend currently always sends full form so this is safe but a PATCH-style merge is safer (same comment as iteration-2).
No cross-worker lock in TestChangePin; cross-worker race under xdist loadscope is pre-existing — recommend running change-pin tests in isolation or adding a module-level xdist group.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of church-name UI + live display flows

seed_data_creation: Set church_name='Test Grace Chapel' + custom positions during UI test, then reset: church_name='', register appearance reset to its own defaults (panel_opacity=100), bible appearance reset to its own defaults (panel_opacity=0), no images, bible display mode='idle', pin_attempts cleared, PIN=1234.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run full suite deterministically use `pytest -n 0` (serial). Church-name tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_church_name.py and cleanup is idempotent in teardown_module. Public preview URL for this app is https://church-live-display.preview.emergentagent.com (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env). PIN input on /settings-admin is autoFocus; use page.keyboard.type('1234'). ChurchName component renders two slot elements (top/bottom) and shows only the one matching data-position prefix, so always probe both data-testid='church-name-top' and data-testid='church-name-bottom'.
